name: DoomFhirpath
title: Hangar Assessment (FHIRPath edition)
description: A first-person shooter implemented entirely in FHIRPath. No JavaScript: the game state is replayed from your input with aggregate() and every frame is ray-marched by calculatedExpression. Works in any SDC renderer built on fhirpath.js >= 3.13 (e.g. NLM LHC-Forms, CSIRO Smart Forms).

valueExpression.name: state
valueExpression.expression: %cmds.aggregate(defineVariable('_c', $this) .defineVariable('_s', $total.split(',')) .defineVariable('_x', %_s[0].toInteger()) .defineVariable('_y', %_s[1].toInteger()) .defineVariable('_d', %_s[2].toInteger()) .defineVariable('_hp', %_s[3].toInteger()) .defineVariable('_k', %_s[4].toInteger()) .defineVariable('_st', %_s[5]) .defineVariable('_cl', %_s[6]) .defineVariable('_dx', iif(%_d = 1, 1, iif(%_d = 3, -1, 0))) .defineVariable('_dy', iif(%_d = 2, 1, iif(%_d = 0, -1, 0))) .defineVariable('_m', iif(%_c = 'w', 1, iif(%_c = 's', -1, 0))) .defineVariable('_ti', (%_y + %_dy * %_m) * %W + %_x + %_dx * %_m) .defineVariable('_tc', iif(%_cl.contains('|' & (%_ti).toString() & '|'), '.', %map.substring(%_ti, 1))) .defineVariable('_mv', %_m != 0 and %_tc != '#' and %_tc != 'I') .defineVariable('_nx', iif(%_mv, %_x + %_dx * %_m, %_x)) .defineVariable('_ny', iif(%_mv, %_y + %_dy * %_m, %_y)) .defineVariable('_nd', iif(%_c = 'a', (%_d + 3) mod 4, iif(%_c = 'd', (%_d + 1) mod 4, %_d))) .defineVariable('_hit', iif(%_c = 'f', %range8.select((%_y + %_dy * $this) * %W + %_x + %_dx * $this) .where(iif(%_cl.contains('|' & ($this).toString() & '|'), '.', %map.substring($this, 1)) != '.' and iif(%_cl.contains('|' & ($this).toString() & '|'), '.', %map.substring($this, 1)) != '+').first(), {})) .defineVariable('_kill', iif(%_hit.exists(), %map.substring(%_hit, 1) = 'I', false)) .defineVariable('_pick', %_mv and %_tc = '+') .defineVariable('_ncl', %_cl & iif(%_kill, %_hit.toString() & '|', '') & iif(%_pick, %_ti.toString() & '|', '')) .defineVariable('_hp1', iif(%_pick, iif(%_hp + 25 > 100, 100, %_hp + 25), %_hp)) .defineVariable('_near', %imps.where(%_ncl.contains('|' & $this.toString() & '|').not() and defineVariable('_ix', $this mod %W).defineVariable('_iy', $this div %W) .defineVariable('_sx', iif(%_ix > %_nx, 1, iif(%_ix < %_nx, -1, 0))) .defineVariable('_sy', iif(%_iy > %_ny, 1, iif(%_iy < %_ny, -1, 0))) .defineVariable('_dist', (%_ix - %_nx).abs() + (%_iy - %_ny).abs()) .select((%_ix = %_nx or %_iy = %_ny) and %_dist <= 4 and %range8.where($this < %_dist) .where(iif(%_ncl.contains('|' & ((%_ny + %_sy * $this) * %W + %_nx + %_sx * $this).toString() & '|'), '.', %map.substring((%_ny + %_sy * $this) * %W + %_nx + %_sx * $this, 1)) = '#').empty()) ).count()) .defineVariable('_hp2', %_hp1 - 8 * %_near) .defineVariable('_nst', iif(%_hp2 <= 0, 'dead', iif(%_mv and %_tc = 'X', 'won', 'play'))) .defineVariable('_msg', (iif(%_kill, 'IMP DOWN!', iif(%_c = 'f', '*BLAM* (missed)', iif(%_pick, 'Picked up a medikit (+25)', iif(%_m != 0 and %_mv.not(), 'Blocked.', '')))) & iif(%_near > 0, ' Imp fireball! -' & (8 * %_near).toString() & ' HP', '')).trim()) .select(iif(%_st != 'play', $total, %_nx.toString() & ',' & %_ny.toString() & ',' & %_nd.toString() & ',' & iif(%_hp2 < 0, 0, %_hp2).toString() & ',' & (%_k + iif(%_kill, 1, 0)).toString() & ',' & %_nst & ',' & %_ncl & ',' & %_msg)), '1,14,0,100,0,play,|,You wake up in a hangar. Something growls.').split(',')

valueExpression.name: pix
valueExpression.expression: 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'.toChars().select($index).select(defineVariable('xm', $this mod 4) .defineVariable('cam', 2.0 * $this / %PW - 1) .defineVariable('rx', %dx + %plx * %cam) .defineVariable('ry', %dy + %ply * %cam) .defineVariable('t', %tsteps.where(defineVariable('ci', (%py + %ry * $this).floor() * %W + (%px + %rx * $this).floor()).select(iif(%cleared.contains('|' & (%ci).toString() & '|'), '.', %map.substring(%ci, 1)) = '#' or iif(%cleared.contains('|' & (%ci).toString() & '|'), '.', %map.substring(%ci, 1)) = 'I' or iif(%cleared.contains('|' & (%ci).toString() & '|'), '.', %map.substring(%ci, 1)) = 'X')).first()) .defineVariable('tt', iif(%t.exists(), %t, %TMAX)) .defineVariable('hi', (%py + %ry * %tt).floor() * %W + (%px + %rx * %tt).floor()) .defineVariable('hc', iif(%t.exists(), %map.substring(%hi, 1), ' ')) .defineVariable('side', (%px + %rx * (%tt - %TSTEP)).floor() != (%px + %rx * %tt).floor()) .defineVariable('band', iif(%tt < 1.5, 0, iif(%tt < 3, 1, iif(%tt < 5, 2, 3))) + iif(%side, 1, 0)) .defineVariable('h', iif(%PH / %tt > %PH, %PH, (%PH / %tt).floor())) .defineVariable('top', ((%PH - %h) / 2).floor()) .defineVariable('u', iif(%side, %py + %ry * %tt, %px + %rx * %tt)) .defineVariable('ui', ((%u - %u.floor()) * 16).floor()) .defineVariable('wall', iif(%t.exists().not(), %zeros.substring(0, %h), iif(%hc = 'I', %zeros.substring(0, %h).toChars().select(%imptex.substring(%ui * 16 + ($index * 16 / %h).floor(), 1)).join(''), iif(%hc = 'X', %exitpat.substring(%top, %h), %dith.substring((%band * 4 + %xm) * %PH + %top, %h))))) .defineVariable('nf', %PH - %top - %h) .select(%zeros.substring(0, %top) & %wall & %floorpat.substring(%xm * %HALF + %HALF - %nf, %nf)))

item.text: Type commands into the box below, one letter per action: W forward, S back, A turn left, D turn right, F fire. Kill the imps (horned faces), grab medikits (+ on the automap) and reach the exit (striped door, box on the automap). Imps hit you every turn while they can see you (same row or column, up to 4 squares). Delete letters to undo time.

valueExpression.expression:
iif(%status = 'dead', '





Y O U   A R E   D E A D

Delete some letters from the command box to undo time.', iif(%status = 'won', '





L E V E L   C O M P L E T E

Please submit this questionnaire to your physician.', %crows.select(defineVariable('o', $this * 4).select( %ccols.select(defineVariable('a', %pix[2 * $this]).defineVariable('b', %pix[2 * $this + 1]) .select(%braille.substring( %a.substring(%o + 0, 1).toInteger() + 2 * %a.substring(%o + 1, 1).toInteger() + 4 * %a.substring(%o + 2, 1).toInteger() + 64 * %a.substring(%o + 3, 1).toInteger() + 8 * %b.substring(%o + 0, 1).toInteger() + 16 * %b.substring(%o + 1, 1).toInteger() + 32 * %b.substring(%o + 2, 1).toInteger() + 128 * %b.substring(%o + 3, 1).toInteger(), 1)) ).join(''))).join('\n')))
iif(%status = 'won', 'Discharged (level complete)', iif(%status = 'dead', 'Deceased', 'Still in the hangar'))
